regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (only 5 of 17 themes eligible), with Banks and Energy as the two leaders, and an absolute-trend gate that has historically helped control drawdowns in Hong Kong. No theme is crowded and the rotation is not directional, so this is a dispersion/focus read rather than a broad regime shift. The track record is strong on direction (26 calls, 25 hits), but the sample is small and the dominant macro narrative is thin (n=1, fully unscheduled).
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) closes the 0.184 rank margin over Banks (H + HK) and holds its 0.8 durability bar — a confirmed swap in leadership would retire this watch and prompt a re-weight of the top two themes.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks rank first with the highest durability bar (0.63) and moderate breadth (0.615), and it is the only leader not showing a crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate marks it eligible, which on this market's history has been the validated drawdown-control leg. I lean it structurally rather than on momentum rank alone.
theses.dissent: Banks have mean-reverting episodes in Hong Kong and rank-IC on the clean sector universe is near zero, so leadership persistence cannot be assumed; the gate controls risk but does not forecast return.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) lag the Hang Seng benchmark by more than 3% between now and the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy sits second with a strong trend health tag (hurst=trend), the highest breadth of any eligible theme (0.9), and a durability bar of 0.8. It is also eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The wide breadth and trend tag support continued staying power, though the rank gap to Banks is small.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership can fade quickly on global commodity or policy shocks, and the margin over the challenger is thin (0.184), so the handoff is not confirmed.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) trades below Banks (H + HK) by more than 2% before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: China Platform Megacaps ranks second-last (15 of 17) with the weakest trend health among scorable names (mixed), low breadth (0.111), and a durability bar of 0.18. It is ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the one validated risk-control leg on this market. Avoiding it is a discipline call, not a short.
theses.dissent: Platform megacaps are not crowded and could bounce on a policy or liquidity surprise; avoiding them forfeits any sharp rebound, and the detector has no short edge.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps outperforms the Hang Seng by more than 5% before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
